title: Corpus Luteum Lifespan
text: Without HCG from a pregnancy, the corpus luteum only lasts about 10-14 days. It then degenerates into the corpus albicans, causing progesterone to fall rapidly.

title: Progesterone and the Uterine Lining
text: Progesterone maintains the thick, blood-rich endometrium (uterine lining). When progesterone drops, the blood vessels constrict, the lining breaks down, and it is shed along with blood - this is menstruation.
